name: Airwolf YFR068 / A5
why_interesting: An exact 700×40C frameset lead with a relatively road-like secondary geometry table and a low enough frame weight to merit further verification.
missing: Legal manufacturer identity and current exact-SKU provenance
Current mainland price, stock and purchase route
Model-specific mainland warranty and quality-control route

facts.frame: Toray T1100 UD carbon storefront listing with internal cable routing
facts.frame_material: Toray T1100 carbon with UD finish; fork and seatpost are also listed as carbon
facts.frame_construction: Internally routed disc-brake gravel frame with BBright 46×79 mm shell; exact lay-up and molding process are not published
facts.stiffness_evidence: An exact-model owner comparison reports a calmer, predictable ride but less front-end stiffness than a Giant TCX, attributed mainly to torsional flex in the supplied stem; qualitative build-specific evidence, not a measured frame result

source_note: This exact YFR068/A5 record replaces the former generic Airwolf current-gravel lead; sibling YFR003 evidence is not transferred. The exact storefront supports the specifications above. A separate exact-model Shimano R7020 complete listing conflicts between 8.4 kg in its title and 8.2 kg in its body, so neither value is transferred to this frameset record. The secondary size-54 geometry is 555 mm stack, 388 mm reach, 72° head angle, 420 mm chainstays and 1,010 mm wheelbase, but it is not promoted as official until it can be matched to the current product. Full-aero status remains unresolved.
